name: Rebecca Minkoff
notes: Store meta: Los Angeles, California, USD, ships to US, CA and one more (https://rebeccaminkoff.com/meta.json). About: 'An industry leader in accessible luxury handbags'; 'Rich leathers and suedes, bohemian-inspired prints' (https://www.rebeccaminkoff.com/pages/about).

Free returns on all U.S. orders with the included FedEx label, within 30 days of delivery; final-sale items not returnable (https://www.rebeccaminkoff.com/policies/refund-policy). No domestic free-shipping threshold stated (international free over $300) (https://www.rebeccaminkoff.com/policies/shipping-policy).

Named: Megan Shoulder Bag $228 (100% genuine leather suede, signature dog-clip detail, 10 x 6 x 2.5 in.), Darren Shoulder Bag $378 (suede leather), Torin Minaudiere Clutch $138, Billie Hobo With Fringe $428. 44 of 137 listings marked down excluded.
